grammar_focus: 复习 KS16/40/64 条件句 if(方案B换情节包):真实条件(if + 现在时, will/should do)、与现在事实相反的非真实条件(if + 过去式, would do;if I were you)、与过去事实相反的非真实条件(if + had done, would have done),以及 if 条件从句里不用 will、用现在时表将来的规则
scene: 如果你在学校丢了东西,应该去查一下失物招领箱。上周,要不是我去查了一下,我的背包就永远找不回来了。“如果我是你,”朋友说,“我会把名字写在每样东西上。”要是每个人都给自己的东西贴上标签,那箱子就不会这么满了。“要是你找到我的包,请给我打电话,”我对办公室说。当初我要是再细心点,这事就不会发生了。“它一旦出现,我们就通知你,”办公室的职员说。你只要礼貌地问,大家通常都会帮你。第二天——说来你可能不信——我的包就在我课桌上!以后我要是再丢东西,我就完全知道该怎么办了。

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS16/40/64 条件句 if
grammar_card.intro: if 条件句分两大类:①真实条件——可能发生的事,if + 一般现在时,主句用 will / should / 祈使句(If you lose something, you should check the box);②非真实条件(虚拟)——与事实相反的假设。又分两种:与现在相反,if + 过去式,主句 would do,be 一律用 were(If I were you, I would label everything);与过去相反,if + had done,主句 would have done(If I hadn't checked it, I would have lost my bag)。要点:if 条件从句里不用 will,要用一般现在时表将来(If it turns up, we will let you know)。

rows: 真实条件(if + 现在, will/should)
If you lose it, you should check the box.
与现在相反(if + 过去式, would do)
If I were you, I would label everything.
与过去相反(if + had done, would have done)
If I hadn't checked, I would have lost it.
If it turns up, we will let you know.

specialRules.rule: 美语“橡皮擦”说 eraser(英式 rubber);“失物招领处”说 lost-and-found(英式 lost property)。本课已按美语写。
与现在相反的假设,be 动词一律用 were(即使主语是 I/he/she);与过去相反用 if + had done → would have done;真实条件的 if 从句里不用 will。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What should you do if you lose something at school?

passage: If you lose something at school, you should check the lost-and-found box. Last week, if I hadn't checked it, I would have lost my backpack forever. "If I were you," my friend said, "I would put my name on everything." If everyone labeled their things, the box wouldn't be so full. "If you find my bag," I told the office, "please call me." If I had been more careful, this wouldn't have happened. "If it turns up, we will let you know," the secretary said. If you ask politely, people usually help you. The next day, if you can believe it, my bag was on my desk! If I ever lose something again, I will know exactly what to do.
